origin.description: Projection onto the affine set C x = b. The distance is the norm of the projection.
origin.usage: affineproj(x0, C, b, unbound = TRUE, maxniter = 100)

arguments.name: unbound
arguments.text: Ignore the positivity constraint when true.

arguments.name: maxniter
arguments.text: Iteration cap for the positive case.

origin.details: Project (0, 5) onto the line whose first coordinate is 2.
origin.value: Projection onto the affine set C x = b. The distance is the norm of the projection.
